metadata.title: Strong Chollet inequalities for all finite simple graph Laplacians: complete Lean proof

affiliations.name: School of Computer Science and Engineering, South China University of Technology

metadata.description:
Strong Chollet inequalities for the Laplacian of every finite simple undirected unweighted graph and every principal vertex subset, retaining the original graph degrees. Empty, singular, isolated and disconnected cases are included. The stronger intermediate result allows arbitrary nonnegative diagonal additions. No arbitrary weighted-graph or general positive-semidefinite Chollet theorem is claimed.

Version 2.0 preserves the earlier written proof and adds a complete independent Lean project, frozen at Git commit 4d2eefd40ee930216ccd8fc0f51e4bf694251967. The fixed verification records report fresh compilation of 83 modules and empty-kernel trust-level-zero replay of 985 owned declarations and 44,173 transitive dependencies. The archive publication checked source hashes and recorded evidence, and did not itself rerun the Lean compilation or kernel replay. The written and formal proofs use distinct methods; their entry points and reproduction instructions are included.

Version 1, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23248359, remains the earlier written-only record. No external human peer review or historical priority certification is claimed. AI assisted research, proof review and formalization. No external funding. Existing licenses and third-party notices are preserved; otherwise original material remains all rights reserved.
